aiResearchSummary.text: Smartcar is researching a system and method for processing vehicle requests that receives a vehicle request for a vehicle parameter from a client system, verifies client access, and determines parameter values for the requested vehicle. Based on this abstract and title, Smartcar is developing secure, permissioned access and data processing infrastructure that integrates mobility applications with connected car data. Overall, Smartcar focuses on request handling, authorization, and standardized vehicle data delivery.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $24,000,000, or 66.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,070,413 to $134,441,275, a 13.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
